evidence.name: Screen field: Inner spacing around the label
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Inner spacing around the label" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Inner spacing around the label
sections.description: Sets the breathing room between the label or icon and the purchase button's edges, set separately for top, bottom, left, and right. More padding makes the button taller and easier to tap; too little looks cramped. Generous top and bottom padding helps your main purchase button feel substantial and inviting to press.
